column1: In 2023, Meta and five other leading corporations launched CEPA↗ to support and encourage supplier
renewable energy purchases, to further decarbonization of global supply chains. The founding
organizations pooled their expertise and internal training resources to design a shared training curriculum
and delivery processes that enable trainees to rapidly mature as clean energy customers.
Recognizing that clean energy purchases in the supply chain are one of the core strategies most
companies can leverage to reduce Scope 3 emissions, the Academy will educate supplier partners on
how they can achieve climate progress through renewable energy purchases. CEPA will also foster new
